variants.prompt: The ravishing French beauty reclines on plush, crimson silk sheets in a dimly lit, opulent boudoir. Honey-blonde waves cascade down her back as she gazes at the viewer with a sultry, inviting emerald stare. Fitted with delicate gold accents, a sheer, lace-trimmed teddy clings to her curves, barely concealing the porcelain skin kissed by Parisian sunbeams. Shapely legs extend towards a gilded four-poster bed, strappy heels discarded on the floor. The cinematic close-up captures her striking features, softened by the shallow depth of field and warm, golden bokeh.
